at-0001.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0006.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key and check it first
at-0006.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. `refund` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`, check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an existing entry with that key before any state validation, return the original result, and include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working).
